extracted.name: Toad in the hole for two people
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member CookDoc and has not been tested by our team.
ingredient_lines: 4 good sausages (my preference is Porky White's Surrey pork sausages)
instruction_lines: Pre cook veg. I do new potatoes, carrots and peas. Place in pyrex bowl, cover with cling film, and bung in the microwave oven to wait!

Pour 1/4 pint of milk into a jug. Add two eggs and whisk. Put 2oz of plain flour in a bowl, add the whisked eggs and milk, and whisk well for a couple of minutes. Pour back into the jug and place on one side.
Heat oven to 200/180 fan. Cover base of 23cm square baking tray with drizzle of olive oil. Put in oven - middle shelf to heat.
When up to temperature slide out tray, put sausages in, and toss them about. Then into oven - but only for a couple of minutes.

Now give the mix in the jug a final whisk. Slide out baking tray, position sausages to keep them separate, then gently pour in the batter mix. Return to oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Keep an eye on them, and when ready give the veg a blast in the microwave, and make some gravy.
